__comment: Height cools you, everywhere in the overworld, on top of whatever the biome and the season
Priority. Thermoo applies every matching environment in priority order, highest first, onto one
shared component builder, and a climate's provider SETS the temperature rather than adding to
it. So a shift has to run after all of them or it is simply overwritten. The default priority is
1000; this is 100, and the cave definition is 90, which is the only thing making the order
Overworld only. #minecraft:is_overworld carries every vanilla biome and, through Terralith's own
addition of #terralith:all_terralith_biomes, all 84 of its biomes as well - which is the whole
modded overworld in this pack. Height means nothing in the Nether, where the roof is at 128 and
all of it is indoors, and the End has no ground to measure from.
The rate is 1 C per 10 blocks, not the atmosphere's 6.5 C per kilometre. See Altitude.java for
why the real number is unusable against a 30 C comfort band.
max_shift caps the cooling at 25 C, which is reached at y 313 and so is a guard rather than a
limit anyone will meet by climbing.
To remove the altitude term, delete this file.
